landings.subject: 0.22.4: write timeout follows worker activity: warn at 15 min with no worker output, stop at 25, cap 120 (write_idle_warn_min, write_idle_stop_min, write_cap_min); after any stop the worker tree, including background shells in their own groups, is proven dead before a retry, and a survivor fails the node instead of a second writer in the same slot

0.22.5: verify and review briefs carry the engine's check results (id, group, command, status or skip reason, exit, duration, log); a check skipped by its path trigger is proven by design; the engine settles only an item naming exact check ids that are green or path-skipped on the current tree, never one with a hedge or negation

0.22.6: a bead branch held by an old worktree no longer fails slot reset: a clean holder is removed, a dirty one detached (files kept), a live one means taken; a bead that fails before its engine starts rests 1 h for every loop and never counts toward a loop's 2-in-a-row stop; reset failures name bead, slot and git's error

0.23.0: dashboard: answering an ask needs no token from this Mac or the Tailscale network (any other source still does), and never a browser prompt; every ask carries click-to-answer options: verify Right/Wrong, over-budget Run again, re-plan cap Allow one more, decisions 2-4 options with cost and the recommended one first (required in plan, write and review schemas)

0.23.1: checks: a check that timed out is never retried; per-check timeout_min; identical checks run once per block (keyed on command, cwd, timeout); later checks get TL_CHECK_LOG_<ID> and TL_CHECK_RC_<ID> of configured checks that ran, and the planner is told to read them instead of re-running; time waiting for a Unity slot, lane or editor lock is capped at wall time and excluded from budget_min; budget_min_by_label

0.23.2: resumed writers get only what changed (failing checks or findings, last-stage note, unchecked items, worker rules, the brief file path; the brief file is rewritten each round); above write_fresh_above_k context (claude 150k, codex 200k) a fresh writer starts with brief, plan, last block, diff stat and summary; write_rounds trace prompt size, context and fresh

0.23.3: verify never parks a bead on an item no check can prove: items about the engine's own later steps (only ones it will do) are settled; checkable items go back to the writer to add a proving test (an unproven round counts as a failed fix round, never lands); external facts with a cited source and taste land with an 'Unverified, for the owner' list on one owner-review bead per epic (locked); kinds only get stricter; owner decisions still ask
0.23.4: dashboard: a lane out past today shows the day (Codex out until Tue 15:38), and an end that has passed is called out instead of a bare old time

0.23.5: every output contract goes to the worker in strict form (all properties required, optional ones nullable) and the answer is mapped back before validation: Codex strict mode had rejected 'source' and 'accept_files' as optional
0.23.6: a malformed request from the lane (bad_request, schema it rejects, unknown argument) fails the run as infrastructure: bead stays open, no ask, 1 h shared rest, 2 in a row stop the loop
